preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 2000.
The length of the sequence N must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence A must be a positive integer between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must contain N-1 space-separated integers for each test case.
Each output integer must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) <= N for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer must not exceed the length of the sequence N.
